what: what the teacher's stage-1 topology costs, and one way to make it fail that looks like something else

measured_2026_09_21.conditions: on the 16-core GPU box while a GPU label build held ~21 GiB, so this is a busy-box figure, not a clean benchmark
measured_2026_09_21.what_it_yields: active_parent_cells, and patches tagged BOX_XMIN..BOX_ZMAX plus MACRO_CUT_FACE on a genuine cut cell

previously_filed_and_not_in_conflict.note: twice the workers and an idle box; the two figures are consistent with each other

failure_mode_worth_knowing.symptom: concurrent.futures.process.BrokenProcessPool, which reads exactly like an out-of-memory kill
failure_mode_worth_knowing.cause: compile_topology uses a process pool, so any script that calls it needs an if __name__ == '__main__': guard; without one the child re-imports the module, re-runs the body, and the pool dies
failure_mode_worth_knowing.how_it_was_diagnosed: the pool's stderr carried the standard 'freeze_support() ... Safe importing of main module' text, which was only visible once the worker count was lowered enough for the message to survive
failure_mode_worth_knowing.wasted: two runs, first blamed on the cgroup ceiling
